page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Main text in one block of full-width lines. Two margin notes at the right: "Loci communes" at the top, and a three-line note beside "in mysteriis" and the following lines. Gathering mark at the foot. The strips at the left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

page.notes: Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are excluded. Italic and roman runs in the body are approximate where the scan is faint.
